title: Patient Financial Assistance Program: Reassessing a Case's Percent of the Poverty Guideline on Countable Income
content:
**Rule.** Under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, a submitted application that carries no documents-requested date and is not a renewal application (one submitted while the household's award is approved) has its percent of the poverty guideline reassessed as the countable percent, recorded together with the income tier that percent falls in, whether or not the tier changes; a renewal application keeps the tier its renewal assessment gave it.

| The case | Under this rule |
|---|---|
| Submitted, no documents-requested date, not a renewal application | Its percent is reassessed as the countable percent and recorded with the income tier that percent falls in |
| Submitted, no documents-requested date, tier unchanged by the reassessment | Still reassessed and recorded, the tier being recorded as it stands |
| A renewal application | Keeps the tier its renewal assessment gave it |

The result this policy governs is the reassessed percent of the poverty guideline recorded on the case, with its tier.

## The reassessment tool

`reassess_assistance_percent_a70c4477` records a reassessment of a financial-assistance case's percent of the federal poverty guideline and the tier that goes with it, while the case is still being decided. One call replaces the percent and the tier recorded on the case. The household size and the annual household income already recorded stay as they are, and nothing else is changed or checked. On success the case shows the new percent and tier.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reassess_assistance_percent_a70c4477` and then calls it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `assistance_case_id` | The reference number of the assistance case being reassessed, as returned by the assistance-case lookup | Reference number |
| `fpl_percent` | The reassessed percent of the federal poverty guideline | A percent with 1 decimal place (precision 0.1), already rounded to 1 decimal place before the call |
| `variant_name` | The tier recorded with the reassessed percent | Exactly one of: `Financial Assistance 25% Discount` (the percent falls in the 25% income band); `Financial Assistance 50% Discount` (the 50% income band); `Financial Assistance 75% Discount` (the 75% income band); `Financial Assistance Full Discount` (the full-discount income band); `Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount` (the case rests on a program enrollment); `Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment` (the case is assessed under the medical hardship adjustment) |

### Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of a record with `status` "reassessed", `assistance_case_id` (echoed), `fpl_percent` (the percent now recorded, one decimal place) and `variant_name` (the tier now recorded).
